children: Q3 revenue fell 1.4% to $798.5M from $809.5M a year earlier, while adjusted EBITDA rose to $54.4M from $44.4M. JELD-WEN maintained 2026 revenue guidance of $3.1B–$3.2B and adjusted EBITDA guidance of $120M–$150M.
Adjusted EBITDA improved year over year, though the release cites tariff refunds and cost factors as contributors.
Revenue declined from $809.5M as volume/mix fell 2%, partly offset by 1% price realization.
The range is unchanged and implies core revenue decline of approximately 2%–5% versus 2025.
The company retained its range despite a softer market outlook; continued price/cost and volume pressure remain.
Cash use improved from $141.6M in the prior-year period, but remains a material liquidity draw.

This is a quarterly update showing improved adjusted profitability but continued revenue softness, within the company's existing full-year outlook. A larger catalyst would require subsequent results to demonstrate sustained margin improvement, stronger revenue trends, or a change to guidance.
